# Trusted dynamic-profile fixture

`udi-ring-profile.json` is a JSON-equivalent copy of
`UniversalDevicesInc/ring/profile.json` at commit
`3647a626c0ea0a5c1c2aa10430861147a2f5925f`. The repository is MIT licensed.
It is a current Universal Devices plugin that calls `updateJsonProfile()` with
this payload. Tests use it as an independent, known-working contract fixture;
it is not included in the eisy-onewire plugin archive.

Source: <https://github.com/UniversalDevicesInc/ring/blob/3647a626c0ea0a5c1c2aa10430861147a2f5925f/profile.json>
